name: @smurg/relay
description: smurg relay: Cloudflare Worker + Durable Objects (WorkspaceDO, TransferDO). Forwards ciphertext only.

scripts.dev: node ../../scripts/assert-env.mjs && node scripts/ensure-web-dist.ts && node scripts/ensure-dev-vars.ts && wrangler dev --env dev --ip 127.0.0.1 --port ${SMURG_RELAY_DEV_PORT:-8787}
scripts.typecheck: node ../../scripts/assert-env.mjs && wrangler types --strict-vars=false --check && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: node ../../scripts/assert-env.mjs && node scripts/check-web-dist.ts && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist --env=""
